mapper.sql: id, task_id, version, content, published_at, published_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_version_snapshot (task_id, version, content, published_at, published_by) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{version}, CAST(#{content} AS JSON), #{publishedAt}, #{publishedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM task_version_snapshot WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY version DESC
